parent.finding: NAND circuit compiler=64/64 3input, independent ANF peer=64/64, NAND complete CPU ~3.2x peer, quartic not fitted.

hypothesis: Compact the FIT-learned NAND-derived causal circuit at training time to a bytewise native 4-bit truth-table lookup, retaining a verifiable learned NAND gate parameter dependency, then show equal-or-lower COMPLETE native CPU/RSS cost versus equally meta-trained independently optimized ANF peer on FRESH sourcefree ternary sanity and new four-input structural source families.
development_order: preregister first, then implementation and sourcefree engineering qualification; synthetic prospective evaluation 1x only after passing Windows/Linux preflight. No previous F124-DC sourcefree cases reused for new prospective metrics.

new_sourcefree_families.name: fresh-ternary-compiler-sanity
new_sourcefree_families.type: three-input bitwise nonlinear primitive with seeded new variable bindings; NOT original F124-DC cases

new_sourcefree_families.name: four-input-parity-conjunction
new_sourcefree_families.type: four-input bitwise XOR of all four inputs combined with quartic AND term, unseen since ternary meta

new_sourcefree_families.name: four-input-selector-with-interaction
new_sourcefree_families.type: four-input bitwise two selectors gating two data roles via nested AND/XOR composition

new_sourcefree_families.name: nibble-addition-carry-out-of-bitwise
new_sourcefree_families.type: four-bit modular carry across bit lanes, source-free reject negative; no assumption fitted

primary_arms.name: compact_meta_NAND
primary_arms.model: infer NAND gate table from 12 meta-task supervision sets; infer arbitrary arity<=4 (5 choose k) causal Boolean truth table and wiring only from novel FIT; compile full NAND DAG at FIT and evaluate on all 2^arity input patterns using actual meta-learned gate to obtain compact LUT, no source tag; execute only byte LUT on CHECK/HELDOUT

primary_arms.name: independent_compact_meta_ANF
primary_arms.model: independently infer XOR+AND meta gate truth tables; independently infer arbitrary arity<=4 causal Boolean function and wiring; synthesize algebraic normal form, compile to compact lookup with meta-learned XOR/AND; use same native bit-packed runtime as primary with independent implementation

secondary_arms.name: slow_meta_NAND_DAG
secondary_arms.model: same candidate meta/FIT and inferred gate/function, but execute DAG recursively for each observed bit, reproducing prior 3.2x structural regression on fresh sourcefree data; no model knowledge advantage

pre_specified_limits: All representational learners receive fixed upper bound of FOUR independent bitwise input variables selected among 5 public nibble registers; new four-input types are within this announced class. Neither learner can infer unbounded arity or cross-bit modular arithmetic. This is structural extension and compiler efficiency, not spontaneous unrestricted primitive invention.
veto: FIT all 192 8-step causal observations exactly, natural CHECK all 8 full autoregressive trajectories exact before qualifying 8 untouched positive+hard-negative heldouts, hard false positive zero, all models evaluate full 8 steps without early exit. No CHECK-driven model choice.
ablation: Compile fixed FIT-learned new DAG twice with real learned NAND and with mutated NAND table then verify generated 2^arity LUT differs; do not claim unlearned ablation comparable to fully trained competitor.

cost.full_OS_wait4: 4 families x 4 seeds x 3 arms x 5 whole Linux OS processes per arm-case =240 total full-process receipts; includes source construction, meta training, FIT, gate compilation, CHECK, heldout; CPU user+sys and peak RSS. Independent audit aggregates all 240 with exact source episode hashes.
cost.resource_threshold: A candidate CPU efficiency claim requires equal or faster aggregate median whole-OS CPU than optimized equally meta-trained ANF on BOTH 4-input families with equal natural correctness. If slower on either, FAIL resource admission. Compare peak RSS and relative costs without claiming equal native FLOPs.
cost.native_parity: Identical event observations, rollout calls and input features, but differing algorithm internal FLOPs, so native-work parity remains unproven even after whole-process CPU/RSS.
